player_0.content: New plan: My previous attempt failed because I assigned a high score (8) to "Defensive," misinterpreting Sonya's confident rebuttals as defensiveness rather than conviction. Sonya's dialogue ("I believe in my vision," "ready to get burned") indicates she is driven and motivated, not threatened or anxious. Next time, I will analyze the character's tone for signs of conviction versus fear. I will assign the highest score to "Inspired" (likely 9 or 10) to reflect her passion for innovation, a moderate score to "Defensive" (perhaps 2 or 3) only for the act of countering Andrew's warnings, and very low scores to "Indifferent" and "Anxious" as they contradict her active engagement. I will ensure the scores accurately reflect the hierarchy of emotions: Inspired > Defensive > Anxious > Indifferent.
